text:
I am very pleased with my experience with DEAR Hearing in Chiang Mai, particularly Oil with whom I had direct contact for my several visits. After suffering sudden hearing loss due to an infection, I researched several hearing aid centers in Chiang Mai, and decided on DEAR Hearing.
Oil provided professional advice without pressure. She patiently responded to my many questions. She did not push higher end hearing aids just to make more money, but instead suggested the hearing aid that was best for me and my budget. In fact, she suggested that I try a hearing aid for one ear only initially as that might be enough to address my problem. At various follow up appointments the service, generally provided by Oil, was excellent.
In addition, her English is very good.
I highly recommend DEAR Hearing.

After losing my hearing aid, I went to Dear Hearing where I was seen immediately. They took care of me very professionally, letting me try one model and then another, more advanced model, which I ultimately chose. The quality of their service and the work they did was truly excellent and efficient; I am very satisfied with their friendly approach (Fitter name : Oil)

Great staff. Always helpful and kind. Easy to understand and very good at explanation new devices and options. Took my mum here and we come back yearly for a service for her hearing aid and any questions she has.
The atmosphere is very calm and highly professional. I am elderly and was handled gently. The information is invaluable. We only get two ears.

Last night one of my hearing aids stopped working die to a loose or broken wire.  Dear Hearing was the closest store to my condo so I went in to see if they could fix it.  Even though they didn’t service my brand they did refer me to a store that did.  I appreciate that they did this very much especially since I can now hear in both ears again!
Ploy and Oil are most efficient and helpful.   I’m quite deaf and now I can hear again

I had a problem with my hearing device and went to the Chiang Mai branch of Dear Hearing. The two ladies who were there were very friendly and tried to solve my problem. That was not possible because I bought the device in Switzerland and they don't have parts for that. Nevertheless they gave their best and refused my try to pay them for their support. Thank you very much Ladies.
Amazing people! Very helpful and good price.

My Widex hearing aides needed adjusting - I went to another nearby shop - there are 2 on Suthep Road but they didn't service Widex.  The shop adjusted my aides at no charge - unusual because few product have a world-wide warranty.  They are more expensive than an online shop but they provide service that you won't find elsewhere.  Wherever you go - hearing aids are expensive.

text: I have to add, even after months after my initial fitting, the staff are super generous with their time and expertise with follow up visits. They provide so much more than simple hardware. They display commendable empathy beyond customer service. I also have tinnitus and they are providers of widex brand which has some excellent tinnitus relief programs.

I wear Widex hearing aids that I purchased in America.  They stopped working all of a sudden, so I went to Dear Hearing and explained my issue.  The audiologist immediately figured out the issue and repaired my hearing aids within 15 minutes. The staff were very friendly and professional.  They also spoke English well enough that I didn't have to use my translator.  Parking is a little tricky but luckily I found a spot.  If I have any issues with my hearing aids in the future, I will definitely return to this shop.  Thank you Dear Hearing for the excellent service.

My mother, age 72, started having hearing problems. She searched for a hearing clinic or center on Google and found Dearhearing Center in Chiang Mai.
She came for a consultation, and the staff were very welcoming. They performed a hearing test using a modern computer system and recommended hearing aids tailored to her needs. The price of the devices was not too high, appropriate for the quality of service she received. They followed up on the use of the devices after 7 days and scheduled appointments for regular check-ups. If anyone has hearing problems, think of Dearhearing! 👍👍👍
I'm a regular customer at this branch; the service is excellent, the staff provides good guidance on using the product, and communication is easy.
